name: single_cell_333m
description: The same zero-shear pulse cell as single_cell_500m, resolved at 333 m instead of 500 m. Phase 2's second scenario: the first config the deck generator was NOT reverse-engineered from, and the first package with a grid that differs from single_cell's (which is what T7's scenario selection must handle). The variant is a pure RESOLUTION change -- sounding, shear, initiation, microphysics, vertical grid, storm duration and output cadence are all byte-identical to scenario 1, so any difference in the storm is attributable to resolution alone and to nothing else.

namelist._note: Differs from single_cell_500m in exactly FIVE values: nx, ny, dx, dy (the resolution change) and dtl (the CFL-limited step that follows from it). Every other key is deliberately identical -- see the description. dz stays 500.0 and ztop is not a scenario key, so the VERTICAL grid is untouched: nz=40 over the template's ztop=18000 m in both scenarios.
namelist._domain_note: 240 x 333 m = 79.92 km, matching scenario 1's 160 x 500 m = 80.00 km to within one coarse voxel. The domain is held constant ON PURPOSE so resolution is the only variable; 333 m does not divide 80 km exactly and chasing that would have changed the box.
namelist._dtl_note: 3.0 -> 2.0 s, the CFL-limited step for 333 m used by the Phase 0 benchmark (docs/phase0-benchmark.md 4). adapt_dt=1 adapts from here; this is the starting step, not a fixed one.
namelist._motion_note: imove stays 0. 10.5 lists imove=1 as a free variant, but Bunkers storm motion is ~0 with no mean wind (iwnd=0), and a non-zero umove would need shear -- which is Phase 3 content. The moving-domain branch stays exercised only by its negative controls until a sheared scenario exists.

provenance.namelist: GENERATED by pipeline/gen_deck.py from this file -- there is no hand-written deck for this scenario, which is the point of T6.
provenance.shear: none (iwnd=0) -- the zero-shear pulse-cell baseline, identical to single_cell_500m

export._note: MEASURED from this run's own active-voxel union (bbox sweep, 2026-07-20), NOT borrowed from single_cell_500m. Grid 126x126x54 @ 333 m. The box is symmetric about (0,0) by construction -- the storm is centred (iorigin=2, imove=0, iwnd=0) and measured PERFECTLY symmetric (+/-18481.5 m in x and y at the peak-active frame, 0.0 m asymmetry) -- which satisfies the UE SVT static-bbox-centre requirement rather than relying on luck.
export._voxel_note: NATIVE 333 m -- the sim grid, no resampling. Deliberately NOT matched to single_cell_500m's 250 m export voxel: that would UPSAMPLE the 333 m data 1.33x, the same anti-pattern the 500m package's own 2x upsample apologises for. Each scenario exports at/near its native voxel; the export voxel tracks the simulation resolution. Consequence: the two packages differ in export voxel (250 vs 333) and grid -- that is fine, because the box is a frame, not data, and 'resolution is the only variable' is a claim about the PHYSICS, not the rendition grid.
export._half_width_note: NX=126, grid centre-extent +/-20812.5 m. CONDENSATE-driven: the active-voxel union half-width is 20.480 km (this storm is more COMPACT than the 500m cell's 23.25 km -- a finer grid resolves a tighter core), and the horizontal |w|>=5 field is narrower still (14.15 km). Tight to the union + ~1 voxel, per sim/README's sizing rule.
export._z_top_note: NZ=54, grid centre-extent to 17815.5 m (~matches the 500m box's 18 km z-top). W-DRIVEN, not condensate-driven: the condensate only reaches 16.25 km, but the stronger 333 m updraft (peak w 67.5 vs 500m's 54.8 m/s) OVERSHOOTS to 17.25 km for |w|>=10 and 18.75 km for |w|>=5. A condensate-tight z-top (16.65 km) clipped a 19 m/s updraft core; this z-top contains |w|>=10 with 0.000% clipped. See _w_crop_caveat.
export._w_crop_caveat: MEASURED w-clip at this box (301-frame sweep, 2026-07-20): |w|>=10 m/s clipped 0.0000%, |w|>=5 m/s clipped 0.0128% (peak clipped |w| 6.98 m/s), |w|>=0.5 m/s clipped 17.66%. The storm-scale updraft and downdraft core are fully contained; what is clipped is broad, weak (5-10 m/s) vertical motion in the 17.8-18 km Rayleigh damping layer (zd=15 km) -- the same character as single_cell_500m's caveat (|w|>=5 clipped 0.005%, peak 6.30 m/s). The box was NOT widened to capture it: it is shared with the VDB, whose bbox centre must stay static, and that weak upper-level w is partly sponge-layer artefact.
